services.desc: For reservations, an adult to child ratio of 1:5 is required. If unable to meet this supervision requirement, a paid staff member will be provided for a fee. Deposit of $50 (non-refundable) or full payment is required at time of booking to hold your reservation. The deposit is meant to hold your space so that no other reservation can be made for the same date/time/space. For all reservations, rooms are cleaned and ready for use.
